name: SmokeMeasureSet
title: Smoke — PAT-253 measure set lineage + edit locks
description: Raw draft MeasureDefinition (POST /api/measures) owned by the seeded demo user. Its measure set must survive a rename of the next version (history / supersede-on-approve key on the set), sharing must span the set, and a test case / CQL library locked by demo must refuse admin's writes with 409 Locked until released.
cqlContent:
library SmokeMeasureSet version '1.0.0'

using FHIR version '4.0.1'

include FHIRHelpers version '4.0.1' called FHIRHelpers

parameter "Measurement Period" Interval<DateTime>

context Patient

define "Initial Population":
  AgeInYearsAt(end of "Measurement Period") >= 18
